title: VisualIdentityConfig
description: Optional brand style file placed at project root. All fields are optional; missing fields use pipeline defaults.

caption_color.description: Primary caption text color (hex #RRGGBB). Falls back to #25E600 on invalid format.

caption_stroke_color.description: Caption text stroke/outline color. Falls back to #000000 on invalid format.

caption_font_size.description: Base caption font size in pixels at reference width.

caption_stroke_width.description: Caption stroke/outline width in pixels at reference font size.

caption_reference_width.description: Reference canvas width in pixels for font-size scaling.

caption_center_x_ratio.description: Horizontal center of captions as a fraction of frame width.

caption_center_y_ratio.description: Vertical center of captions as a fraction of frame height.

caption_safe_width_ratio.description: Maximum caption width as a fraction of frame width (safe zone).

caption_max_words.description: Maximum number of words per caption group.

caption_max_gap.description: Maximum silence gap (seconds) between words before splitting a caption group.

caption_max_duration.description: Maximum duration (seconds) of a single caption group.
